670:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

670:t_1:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it, I can't take this...」

670:t_1:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「It's been three days already since we got trapped in this closed dimension...」

670:t_1:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「They keep sending in $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#pilot$$s a few at a time, but I'd bet that's that bastard $$ミカゲ$$'s doing too.」

670:t_1:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「He's out to wear us down mentally, huh... That grudge-holding $$堕天翅$$ creep's pettiness is hardened Super Alloy Z, I tell you.」

670:t_1:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「And once we're completely worn out, he intends to hit us with an all-out attack.」

670:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That time probably isn't far off...」

670:t_1:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come on, $$ノノ$$. Don't make such a gloomy face. A time like this is exactly when you have to smile.」

670:t_1:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-Yes! Big Sis... I mean, $$ノリコ$$!」

670:t_1:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems even $$ノノ$$ is a little worn down.」

670:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No matter the situation, I get through it with hard work and guts! That's $$ノノ$$!」

670:t_1:16.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is spinning her wheels...」

670:t_1:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She really does seem to be worried about $$ラルク$$, after all...」

670:t_1:18.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are both $$バスターマシン$$ riders, even if they're from different worlds... They try too hard with their hard work and guts.」

670:t_1:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on a second, Sis $$カズミ$$!」

670:t_1:20.en:
$$マオ$$
「Never mind $$ノノ$$, but $$ラルク$$ and hard work and guts...?」

670:t_1:22.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But wouldn't you say someone with no hard work or guts couldn't be an ace, or come up with that $$雷王星$$ drop of hers?」

670:t_1:24.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「As expected of the Queen of Roses... You don't let needless preconceptions fool you, and you see the Princess very well.」

670:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... everyone's version of hard work and guts is different.」

670:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Some guys, like $n, are at simulations and special training all year round, and others, like $$ラルク$$, keep it hidden.」

670:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I knew about it. She... always joined my training, acting like she had no choice.」

670:t_1:28.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Right, right. And when we were done, she'd give me advice, all smug and snide, like she was doing me a huge favor.」

670:t_1:29.en:
$$マリ$$
「In short, any girl they call 'Princess' has the same attribute, nya~.」

670:t_1:30.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You stay out of this, Four-Eyes.」

670:t_1:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone knows a Big Sis that $$ノノ$$ doesn't know...」

670:t_1:34.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Princess changed before anyone noticed.」

670:t_1:35.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's not only the Princess who changed, though.」

670:t_1:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「And the ones who changed the Princess are you, $$ノノ$$... and $c.」

670:t_1:38.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right. And then, of course, there's $$ノリコ$$'s presence.」

670:t_1:39.en:
$n
「So your hard work and guts, you two, influenced $$ラルク$$ too?」

670:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis said... she hates that kind of thing...」

670:t_1:41.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Hard work and guts... Nobody likes pain and suffering.」

670:t_1:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But you know, $$ノノ$$... Both $$ノリコ$$ and $$ラルク$$ know it.」

670:t_1:43.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That you can't do anything without hard work and guts.」

670:t_1:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ is worried... It's like Big Sis is being driven by something...」

670:t_1:47.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... I feel like, if this keeps up, someday... a day will come when Big Sis stops taking care of herself...」

670:t_1:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

670:t_1:53.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any funny ideas.」

670:t_1:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time when everyone feels they have to do that...」

670:t_1:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

670:t_1:58.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you might be stuck over the whole $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$ business...」

670:t_1:59.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially one younger than me.」

670:t_1:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

670:t_1:65.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And I doubt you'll ever forget Major $$グラハム$$ either...」

670:t_1:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any funny ideas.」

670:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time when everyone feels they have to do that...」

670:t_1:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

670:t_1:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you might be stuck over the whole $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$ business...」

670:t_1:73.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially one younger than me.」

670:t_1:79.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

670:t_1:80.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Damn...! If this situation keeps up, we're really in trouble!」

670:t_1:81.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Calm down, $$アンディ$$. Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others are still trying all kinds of ways to break through the dimensional wall.」

670:t_1:82.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But not $$バサラ$$'s song, our last hope, nor $$アンディ$$'s Dimension Tunnel Bullet, nor the drill of $$グレンラガン$$ could shake the dimensional boundary line.」

670:t_1:83.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I'd say $$ミコノ$$ and $$シルヴィア$$ understand the reason.」
